title: Calculate the difference of the total amount spent in all events by the Stu
question:
Calculate the difference of the total amount spent in all events by the Student_Club in year 2019 and 2020.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: The first 4 strings of the event_date values in the event table can represent year; The difference of the total amount spent = SUBTRACT(spent where YEAR(event_date) = 2019, spent where YEAR(event_date) = 2020)

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.XCL_013 = '2019' THEN ex.XCL_020 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.XCL_013 = '2020' THEN ex.XCL_020 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM expense ex
JOIN budget b ON ex.XCL_023 = b.XCL_003
JOIN event e ON b.XCL_009 = e.XCL_010
WHERE e.XCL_011 = 'Student_Club'
  AND e.XCL_013 IN ('2019', '2020')

  (SELECT SUM(b.XCL_005) FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.XCL_009 = e.XCL_010 WHERE substr(e.XCL_012,1,4)='2019') -
  (SELECT SUM(b.XCL_005) FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.XCL_009 = e.XCL_010 WHERE substr(e.XCL_012,1,4)='2020') AS diff
